balance_audit_summary.scope: support contacts only; not a COM/COP stability-margin certificate
balance_audit_summary.raw_force_frame: MuJoCo contact frame; f0 is normal, wrench on geom2; not signed world support force

execution_audit.definition: Actual post-step qvel at500Hz; finite differences include solver transients. 2rad/s default and2mrad soft-limit tolerance are explicit engineering gates, not PDF/factory safety certification.

neutral_stance_definition: Explicit simulation initialization and SONIC input neutral shoulder pitch offset on both arms; left offset held as neutral reference, right follows existing ARDY/task retargeting. Original official decoded motor targets remain untouched. Not a pure initialization-only counterfactual.

clearance_approach.kind: real-wrist full pose raise, then closed-pad task transition
clearance_approach.limits: Task scaffold into SONIC reference only; clearance checks wrist height, not every link. Original solver contacts and actual velocity/limits remain the acceptance evidence.

post_clearance_native_branch.kind: Selected ARDY multistart static IK branch after actual wrist-height clearance

search_state.interpretation: Exact actual state at live static search, not a full policy-history resume snapshot

post_clearance_native_branch.metric_definition: Distance to one COMMON selected-source pose, not each branch own seed. Static thresholds capture1mm/spread2mm/arm margin20mrad/open-table10mm/hand-replan1.5mm; not success-gate relaxations.

coverage.dimensions: standoff_m/lateral_m/azimuth_deg of the pregrasp reference about the REAL cube centre and its REAL rotation (approach profile and which opposing cube face pair the pad line straddles); 2-DOF arm nullspace variants of the best converged pose of that same profile (wrist roll/pitch/elbow at a fixed pinch centre); denser ARDY source-seed sampling than linspace(0,n-1,6)
coverage.rejection_action: a rejected batch REPLANS onto the next batch of the ordered schedule and only the final exhaustion of the schedule aborts the trial

batches.rejection: No candidate passes static capture/hand/limits/open-table filters

kind: ARDY selected reach shape/posture -> geometric pinch retargeting -> official SONIC free-base body control + separate contact-gated fingers; no human grasp endpoint joints
release_height_drop_definition: HOLD end minus late RELEASE/SETTLE_RELEASE cube height; includes prior controlled SETDOWN when enabled, not an isolated free-fall distance

source.body_order: MuJoCo XML hinge order; SONIC remaps to IsaacLab explicitly
source.conversion: native local_rot_mats + root_positions; no angles inferred from posed_joints

orientation_error_metric: closed-hand FK pad vertical spread in METRES

reference_filter.kind: receding C2 quintic; analytic full-segment extrema; consistent q/dq future samples
reference_filter.continuation_rule: reject infeasible replacement; continue the remaining previously certified C2 segment; clamp future sampling time at its zero-velocity/acceleration endpoint; stop if no certified segment exists

endpoint_seed_selection: legacy minimum per-branch OWN-seed deviation; not a common distance to selected ARDY input

kinematic_outer_servo.kind: closed-hand actual FK IK delta added to current SONIC input reference

balance_validation_definition: HOLD support contacts audited separately; full-task COM/COP stability margins are not validated
right_arm_pd_kd_definition: sqrt(kp scale) times independent damping scale during LIFT/HOLD; factory damping elsewhere
postcapture_pd_gain_scope: LIFT/HOLD only; raw official decoded targets unchanged
joint_reference_error_definition: actual arm minus virtual SONIC input reference; not necessarily decoder motor setpoint
object_localization: simulator-state coordinates during DESCEND/ALIGN/CLOSE; not vision
table_placement_definition: only broad table x front changed, back=.87 and top=.757 fixed; cube initial pose/mass/friction and collision masks unchanged; environment placement counterfactual, not algorithm improvement

adaptive_hand.face_region_definition: target centres remain inside the selected cube face region; actual contact margin still requires physics validation
adaptive_hand.preload_definition: finger IK target penetration only; not a physical object weld/force injection or a measured-force guarantee

finger_gain_scope: thumb and selected opposing finger during CLOSE/LIFT/HOLD and optional SETDOWN; original actuator limits and passive joint physics unchanged; not SONIC body gain
post_capture_body_objective: full wrist pose translated vertically from actual capture pose; orientation held
success_gate_change: v2 non-pad cube contacts; v3 free-base HOLD feet/no table/nonfoot floor; v4 actual TABLE support final100ms; optional v5 actual arm speed<=declared limit, body soft-limit overshoot<=2mrad and no robot-table load full task; legacy_gates preserved
generated_lift_timewarp: positive vertical excursion normalized to 10cm, monotone accumulated; explicit task retargeting
fail_reason: native branch static search rejected: No candidate passes static capture/hand/limits/open-table filters
correction_definition: no interactive user text corrections; preconfigured task geometry/environment, simulator-state object location and lift-height retargeting are NOT counted as zero human setup

sonic.body_action_source: official SONIC v1.1 ONNX; no manual/IK arm motor targets; optional causal decoded-target adapter separately labelled
sonic.actuator_adapter: SONIC decoded motor targets + PD; optional explicitly labelled decoded-target filter and MODEL GRAVITY ONLY on right-arm actuator torques; no manual target/generalized-force override

execution_cycle_latency.definition: Host wall time for ten consecutive loop observations incl reference/branch/IK/SONIC/finger/physics/audit/state transitions; no pacing. A failed iteration may stop before physics and is counted separately by the caller. Initial model/motion load and final serialization excluded. This is execution latency, not policy-only latency or measured end-to-end user response.

cube_geometry_entry.seat_rule: cube bottom rests on the support top z=0.757, so body z = 0.757 + half edge
cube_geometry_entry.calibration_frame: source_physics_core.prepare_model() keeps the hardcoded human-demo cube at ([.267,-.118],.7745); deliberately NOT resized or re-seated because it only supplies the local wrist-to-cube-centre offset
cube_geometry_entry.note: edge length is the single variable; geom mass stays at the template 0.020 kg

branch_coverage_definition: N2 ordered candidate-COVERAGE schedule implemented in native_branch.py. Every batch is <=7 candidates judged by the UNCHANGED static thresholds (capture1mm/spread2mm/arm margin20mrad/open-table10mm/hand-replan1.5mm). Batch 0 is exactly the baseline batch. Later batches REPLAN the pregrasp reference about the real cube centre and its real rotation (standoff_m, lateral_m, azimuth in the cube frame = approach side / which opposing face pair), add arm-nullspace wrist-orientation variants of the best converged pose of that profile, and sample ARDY source frames more densely than linspace(0,n-1,6). No failure gate, no static threshold and no candidate-count bound is relaxed. Default off; off reproduces the baseline bit-for-bit.

face_aligned_servo.definition: Optional5Hz virtual-input arm servo during PREGRASP/DESCEND/ALIGN/CLOSE; fixes cube face axis selected by the ARDY-seeded branch, zero nullspace prior, same0.06rad reference-correction cap and C2 envelope. No actual-state or body-motor override; default disabled. Not a contact-stability certificate.

branch_face_alignment_definition: Optional ARDY-seeded static arm IK adds selected cube-face yaw matching and20.05mrad bounds; hand feasibility uses the actual independent-finger preload/face region. Same seven-source-candidate cap and original static/physical filters; virtual SONIC input only, not native ARDY orientation or motor/state override.
finger_table_clearance_definition: Optional finger-IK target height >=table top+pad radius+declared margin, projected inside opposing cube face region. No contact masks/state/torques are overridden; actual solver table gate remains unchanged. Geometry is not a collision-free certificate.

telemetry_schema.format: gzip CSV; 9 significant digits; full result/NPZ floats preserved
